title: Reuse Terminology For CAD
description: Extend the terminology mechanism (already shipped for puzzle 3d) to the CAD app: add a "reuse"/"Wiederverwendung" terminology that remaps CAD's primary entity noun "Object"/"Objects" to "Building component"/"Building components" (en) and "Baukomponente"/"Baukomponenten" (de), consistent with puzzle 3d's wording. Also investigate a user report that the puzzle 3d terminology dropdown wasn't visible (root-caused to a transient WASM-boot timeout under heavy concurrent build load on the machine, not a code defect).
